hooks.name: Cite AWS claims
hooks.description: After the agent edits a walkthrough page, remind it to ground AWS behaviour in the source lock rather than recall.

action.prompt: You just edited a walkthrough page. Before moving on, check it against .kiro/steering/aws-source-lock.md: every AWS behavioural claim on the page must appear in the verified-facts list or be backed by a link in the page's References section. Anything not yet run in an account stays marked as unverified or TBD. If a claim cannot be sourced, re-read the relevant page with the aws-docs MCP server or remove the claim.
